about.en: AC Milan Fan Token (ACM) is the official fan token of the Italian football club AC Milan, issued by Socios.com on the Chiliz Chain, where it lives at 0x062f6004fd0bf204d272ff115e5b84f7a01489d1. Holders use it on the Socios.com app to vote in club polls and to access rewards and fan experiences; it gives no ownership of the club.
